item.title: Version 2.4
item.description:
iPod Drop 2.4

  • See exactly what's happening. While adding, editing or removing songs, iPod Drop shows the song it's working on, how many files are done out of the total, and the percentage.
  • An iTunes-style progress bar. A moving striped bar shows work is continuing even when the percentage pauses.
  • A fresh look. The iPod Drop name and an iPod logo sit in the window's top corner, and the app uses Apple Music's red throughout.
